AttDef.BriefDescription: A base attribute for specifying a job to run in a result.

AssociationsDef.Name: job-task
AssociationsDef.BriefDescription: The task which requires this job to be run.

Directory.Name: case directory
Directory.BriefDescription: The directory holding job inputs and outputs (including log files).

String.Name: job launcher
String.BriefDescription: The utility used to launch job processes.

File.Name: script
File.BriefDescription: Path to the script (relative to the case directory).

File.Name: logs
File.BriefDescription: Path to log files (relative to the case directory) for each script segment.
File.DetailedDescription: Each script may have multiple segments (or stages) that run. No segment will start if a previous segment failed to complete successfully. Each segment will have a different log file. Each segment may run a different number of processes. After each segment completes, the `logs/progress` file will be overwritten with a monotonically increasing integer count.
